description: Test suite for sanitization functions and prompt building in a TypeScript project, using Vitest. It verifies the behavior of functions related to sanitizing prompt inputs and wrapping untrusted data blocks.

methods.name: sanitizeForPromptLiteral
methods.description: Sanitizes input string by removing control characters, Unicode line/paragraph separators, and format characters, preserving normal Unicode characters and spaces.

methods.name: buildAgentSystemPrompt
methods.description: Builds a system prompt string with sanitized workspace and sandbox information.

methods.name: wrapUntrustedPromptDataBlock
methods.description: Wraps sanitized text in a special block marked as untrusted data, with optional character limit.
